advisories.summary: N-Quads injection via unvalidated o_language in knowledge bundle export
advisories.description: The language tag on a literal is interpolated into the N-Quads line without validation or escaping. A tag containing a newline ends the line early, and the remainder is parsed as an additional quad. An exported knowledge bundle can therefore contain triples that were never in the source graph.

advisories.summary: Per-flow service and import/export routes skip workspace scope check, allowing cross-workspace access
advisories.description: The per-flow gateway routes /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/{kind}, /api/v1/flow/{flow}/import/{kind} and /api/v1/flow/{flow}/export/{kind} are authorised against a resource whose workspace is always empty. The IAM decision treats a missing workspace as no scope restriction. A user whose only role is reader or writer in workspace A can therefore query, run RAG and agent requests over, and import data into the flows of any other workspace.
